sentences: The same zero-one matrix can define a transformation using ordinary addition or Boolean OR.
OR is idempotent, so repeated contributions can collapse, while SUM must count them accurately.
The source asks for the largest possible circuit-size gap between these two computation systems.
Depth restrictions lead to additional versions with different known bounds.
The project aims to quantify how much the ability to ignore duplicate contributions changes the cost of computing many related linear-looking outputs at once.
